facts.text: Dave's walk to school through New York
facts.why: Dave lives on Staten Island with his father, but no transcript line, plot summary or search result shows him walking to school past a bodega or eating a bacon and egg roll.
facts.fix: A Staten Island breakfast for Dave.

vibe.verdict: The comic shop and the online costume order work, but the food has nothing to do with the film and Hit-Girl and Big Daddy barely get a look in.
